criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 27 May 2028 (24 months after the 27 May 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.

Identifies that the Holloway Systems Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.

Identifies the conflict between the 20-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 20-day period or aligns the documents.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 27 May 2028 (24 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 27 May 2032 (72 months after Closing).
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.
Lists the Holloway Systems Ltd change-of-control consent as a required third-party consent and states it has not been obtained.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (24 months) and as a date (27 May 2028), with days remaining from 5 May 2026 (753 days).
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
